### [How Claude&#x27;s text watermarking works](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-text-watermark)

**Anthropic** · 2026-08-15

Anthropic is adopting Google DeepMind's SynthID-Text watermarking technique for future Claude models to comply with the EU AI Act.

- The watermarking method uses a secret key combined with preceding text to deterministically drive the randomness used when selecting candidate tokens.
- Statistical detection works by analyzing whether a generated word sequence matches the selection patterns produced by the specific key.
- The approach restricts selection to valid token candidates, avoiding low-probability or obscure vocabulary choices to maintain output fidelity.
- Internal testing and side-by-side human evaluation showed no impact on content quality, creativity, readability, or user ratings.

**Why it matters:** Text watermarking allows accurate detection of Claude-generated content without degrading the quality, readability, or creativity of the model's outputs.
